title: Data-Driven Vision-Language Models for Remote Sensing: A Survey
abstract: arXiv:2610.31304v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: During the deep learning era, innovations in remote sensing (RS) vision models primarily focused on optimizing network architectures for specific tasks and conducting end-to-end training. However, with the advent of the Vision-Language Models (VLMs) era, constrained by substantial computational resource demands, the mainstream research paradigm has shifted towards adapting general-purpose VLMs using RS vertical domain data for fine-tuning, rather than modifying their core architectures. This transition marks a change in the innovation pathway from model-centric to data-centric. Despite the increasing importance of data, the academic community still lacks a systematic, data-centric survey to guide researchers in constructing high-quality RS vision-language datasets for various application scenarios and in conducting effective model fine-tuning and performance evaluation based on these datasets. translated_title: 面向遥感的数据驱动视觉-语言模型：综述
translated_abstract: 在深度学习时代，遥感（RS）视觉模型的创新主要集中在针对特定任务优化网络架构以及进行端到端训练。然而，随着视觉-语言模型（VLMs）时代的到来，受限于巨大的计算资源需求，主流研究范式已转向利用遥感垂直领域数据对通用视觉-语言模型进行微调适配，而非修改其核心架构。这一转变标志着创新路径从以模型为中心向以数据为中心的转变。尽管数据的重要性日益凸显，学术界仍然缺乏一份系统的、以数据为中心的综述，来指导研究人员针对各种应用场景构建高质量的遥感视觉-语言数据集，并基于这些数据集进行有效的模型微调和性能评估。为填补这一空白，本文提出了一……
tldr: 本文是一篇以数据为中心的遥感视觉-语言模型综述，系统梳理了高质量遥感视觉-语言数据集的构建方法，并指导研究人员进行有效的模型微调与性能评估，填补了该领域缺乏系统性数据导向调研的空白。
